item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia continues intensive air and missile attacks on Kyiv, injuring civilians and damaging the Northern Bridge and the city’s power network, while a drone strike ignited an Ozon warehouse in southern Russia. Ukraine responded by striking Russian missile launchers and air-defence systems in Bryansk Oblast and by hitting the Saratov oil refinery. Iran conveyed a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pursues a gas pipeline deal, and Azerbaijan and Ukraine signed new energy-defence and trade agreements, with Zelensky urging Latin America to help rebuild Ukraine’s power grid. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israeli forces continue coalition negotiations, with talks gaining momentum and a candidate named to form the next government, while Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens. item.description:
